S01.sentence: The man on the line sounds warm and sure of himself.

S02.sentence: He says it could double in weeks.

S03.sentence: And he says this chance won't last past Friday.

S04.sentence: Twenty thousand dollars is everything she has.

S05.sentence: He tells her about other customers, regular people, who already doubled their money.

S06.sentence: He makes her feel smart for listening.

S07.sentence: As a teenager, he sold Italian ice on the beach and made thousands of dollars in one summer.

S08.sentence: It grew fast, then went bankrupt.

S09.sentence: He was broke, and looking for a new way to make money.

S10.sentence: His first day as a licensed broker was a Monday.

S11.sentence: Inside, it didn't look like old money at all.

S12.sentence: Many of the brokers were barely twenty.

S13.sentence: Some had no finance background at all.

S14.sentence: What they did have was a script.

S15.sentence: Brokers who didn't were shouted at, or fired.

S16.sentence: The script told them exactly what to say.

S17.sentence: How to sound like an expert.

S18.sentence: And how to never, ever take no for an answer.

S19.sentence: That's exactly what happened to Carol.

S20.sentence: They talked about rockets and secrets and getting in early.

S21.sentence: And the brokers always made sure the insiders sold first.

S22.sentence: Her broker said buy, so she bought.

S23.sentence: Then he said hold, so she held.

S24.sentence: When she finally asked to sell, he talked her out of it, again and again.

S25.sentence: By the time she got out, her twenty thousand dollars had shrunk to about four thousand.

S26.sentence: And her money had helped pay for something she'd never see.

S27.sentence: She thought it was her own fault for trusting a stranger.

S28.sentence: But stop and think about where every one of those dollars came from.

S29.sentence: But the money trail didn't end there.

S30.sentence: And then he made a deal.

S31.sentence: So were other Stratton brokers and executives.

S32.sentence: Meanwhile, many of Stratton's victims were still paying for their losses.

S33.sentence: Carol's name was on that list.

S34.sentence: And that's where the story gets truly ugly.

S35.sentence: Carol got a few small checks over the years.

S36.sentence: But his victims are still waiting for most of it.

S37.sentence: They miss years of honest growth, because they no longer trust anyone.

S38.sentence: Real opportunities don't need to rush you.
